expr: return { summary: document.querySelector('.badge--ok, .badge--err')?.textContent?.trim(), fails: [...document.querySelectorAll('.case[data-status=fail]')].map(c => ({ name: c.querySelector('.case__name')?.textContent, detail: c.querySelector('.case__detail')?.textContent })), skips: [...document.querySelectorAll('.case[data-status=skip]')].map(c => c.querySelector('.case__name')?.textContent) };
